title: The Price of a Story
paras: At a coastal museum, researcher Mina Rao tested whether the story attached to a souvenir could change its value. The shop sold small clay copies of a stone carving: the [[profile|profile]] of a merchant from an ancient trading [[civilization|civilization]]. Although visitors often admired these faces, few bought them. Price was therefore an important [[consideration|consideration]] in planning the experiment.

Over six weekends, 240 visitors saw one of two labels beside identical copies, each priced at twelve coins. One described the merchant's [[exotic|exotic]] clothing and links with distant ports. The other explained how waves had begun to [[erode|erode]] the original carving before a [[crane|crane]] lifted it to safety. Both labels were equally long, and staff alternated them every hour.

The rescue story produced nearly twice as many purchases. Interviews suggested that it helped the shop [[cater|cater]] to visitors who wanted a meaningful reminder rather than a decorative object. One buyer, a [[tailor|tailor]] named Tomas, imagined the [[tense|tense]] minutes when the heavy stone hung above the beach. A notable [[exception|exception]] was a group of costume enthusiasts, who preferred the description of clothing.

The trial did not prove that dramatic stories always increase sales: it involved one object in one museum. Nevertheless, it showed that buyers could respond differently to the same price and product. The shop kept the rescue label, but added a short clothing note so that the merchant's appearance was not forgotten.
zh: 在一家海滨博物馆，研究员米娜·拉奥测试了纪念品所附的故事是否会改变它的价值。商店出售一种石雕的小型陶制复制品，刻画的是某个古代贸易文明中一位商人的侧脸。虽然游客常常欣赏这些面孔，却很少购买。因此，在设计实验时，价格是一个需要认真考虑的重要因素。
在六个周末里，240名游客看到了相同复制品旁两种标签中的一种，每件复制品都标价十二枚硬币。一种标签描述了商人富有异国情调的服饰，以及他与遥远港口的联系。另一种则解释说，海浪已开始侵蚀石雕原件，后来一台起重机将它吊到了安全的地方。两种标签的篇幅相同，工作人员每小时轮换一次。
讲述抢救经过的标签带来的购买量几乎是另一种的两倍。访谈提示，它可能帮助商店满足了这样一类游客的需求：他们想要的是有意义的纪念品，而不仅仅是装饰物。一位名叫托马斯的裁缝买下了复制品，他想象着那块沉重的石头悬在海滩上方时令人紧张的几分钟。一个明显的例外是一群服饰爱好者，他们更喜欢关于衣着的描述。
这项试验并不能证明富有戏剧性的故事总能提高销量，因为它只涉及一家博物馆里的一种物品。不过，试验表明，面对相同的价格和产品，买家可能作出不同反应。商店保留了讲述抢救经过的标签，但也添加了一小段服饰介绍，让人们不至于忽略这位商人的外貌。

q.s: Copies displayed with the rescue account cost more than those with the clothing description.
q.why: 两种标签旁的复制品均标价十二枚硬币。

q.s: Tomas bought two copies of the carving.
q.why: 文中说明托马斯是买家，但未交代购买数量。

q.s: The shop retained the rescue label after the trial.
q.why: 末段明确说商店保留了讲述抢救经过的标签。
